decks.summary: Beginner Akachi from Core through Edge of the Earth: extra charges on Shrivelling and Rite of Seeking, Dragon Pole and Alchemical Transmutation, and Spirit-Speaker to reset spells.
Well-rounded Akachi with tools for everything: Shrivelling and Rite of Seeking, Alchemical Transmutation money, Alyssa Graham and Scrying to see ahead, and Moonlight Ritual ready for Blood Pact.

Grotesque Statue Akachi: Spirit-Speaker bounces the Statue to refill it, so she draws two tokens for every test, with Spirit Athame and Holy Rosary to boost willpower; wants a partner for heavy fighting.
Battle-mage Akachi for Hard: Seal of the Seventh Sign, The Chthonian Stone and Empty Vessel seal away the worst tokens while Shrivelling (5), Spectral Razor and Twila keep the damage coming.
Combo Akachi who lets her own allies die to charge Decorated Skull, then spends those charges through Torrent of Power, with Shrivelling and Rite of Seeking as the core; better in multiplayer.
Simple standalone Akachi: Shrivelling and Rite of Seeking kept charged by Twila Katherine Price and Spirit-Speaker, with Grotesque Statue and Spectral Razor; built for new players and the Blob.
Combat-mage Akachi as the team's fighter: Shrivelling, Enchanted Blade and Mists of R'lyeh charged up by her ability, with Arcane Research for cheap upgrades; great beside Carolyn Fern.
Fantasy Flight's sample starter for Akachi: a spread of charge spells, Arcane Initiate and Uncage the Soul to find and play them, Spirit-Speaker to reset them, and Astral Travel to move.
Bestow Resolve Akachi who commits dual skills like Occult Theory as all-wild icons to any investigator's tests, recharging the Ritual endlessly with Spirit-Speaker for huge oversuccess.
Bangle of Jinxes and Spectral Shield turn enemies into harmless followers, Drain Essence and String of Curses finish them, and Runic Axe is both her weapon and her charge battery; a short guide.
